content: {"episode_id":"ep-05069","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of transient neurological deficits consistent with prior transient ischemic attacks, with a known history of cerebral infarction and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
